name: Infrastructure Change
description: Provision or modify infrastructure — Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, cloud resources.

default_promises.description: Idempotent apply — second run produces no changes

clarifying_questions.question: Is this a production infrastructure change?
Does this affect networking, IAM, or security groups?

example_contract:
CONTRACT: CTR-INFRA001
  TYPE: INFRA:DOCKER
  SCOPE: Dockerfile, docker-compose.yml
  MODULES: deploy
  RISK CAP: HIGH
  PROMISES:
    1. Idempotent apply → verify: diff_inspection
    2. Plan reviewed → verify: manual_review
    3. Rollback documented → verify: diff_inspection
  STATUS: proposed
